description: The authority making itself audible. Uses the sound seam rather than a described one, so it reaches a neighbouring block the way a real one would.
name: Low pass

stage.text: A drone comes over low enough to feel in your teeth, and holds.

lines: The drone is still up there, holding station, close enough to hear.
Everyone on this street has stopped looking up, which took about a minute.
A shadow crosses the road at walking pace and doesn't belong to anything on it.

stage.text: Aerial survey over {place} continues as scheduled — the Basin thanks residents for their patience.
